body:
Triage: lands in `packages/metadata-protocol` (`promoteDraftForPublish` / `publishPackageDrafts`); rationale: measured defect — the denial audit rows roll back with the batch whose refusal they record, so the #7748 invariant (a refusal leaves a trail, in its own vocabulary) is broken on this route. Queued as **Bug**.

- Serial constraints for the claiming seat: land **after #8400** (in flight, same function and same test harness), and **hard same-file serial with #8595** (same `publishPackageDrafts` body) — never the same batch; suggest dispatching the pair to one dev in sequence.
- PM mechanism assumption (falsifiable, not a ruling): option 1 — the helper returns the refusal and each caller audits on its own side of its own transaction — is the contract-first shape; the single-item route already writes outside a transaction. Dev should verify and report a fork if measurement disagrees.
